comment: Vibration / haptics policy for the S10+ (beyond2lte). Read by tools/s10plus/a33/nuxel-haptics-diag.sh. The actuator node is ENUMERATED, never assumed: on this vendor kernel the vibrator may appear as a LED-class device, a timed_output device, or neither. A node existing is not proof that anything is felt — that observation is the owner's, and the felt half of this subsystem is NEEDS_OWNER_TEST.

device.actuator: LRA/ERM haptic driver behind the PMIC (Samsung/TI class), exact node reported at runtime

node_candidates.comment: All candidates are probed; the FIRST that responds wins and its real path is reported. No /dev/input/eventN or /sys path is hard-coded as truth.

global_switch.comment: One persisted switch. When it is off, every path that buzzes (button sounds, notifications, the diagnostic's own test buzz) refuses, and nothing re-enables it at boot.

intensity.comment: If the node exposes no amplitude/strength control, intensity is expressed as DURATION only and the tool says so (intensity_mode=duration) instead of pretending a strength write happened.

patterns.comment: Durations in ms. Patterns are pure data: the FSM/notifier passes a name, the tool expands it. Nothing here runs at boot.

buttons.note: bg-03 button FSM consumes `button`/`gesture` patterns through the shared haptics state file; this tool only owns the switch and the API.

notifications.note: notification daemon consumes `notify`; a notification must never buzz while the global switch is off.
